elements.label: Figure 4.11
elements.title: Developing countries, in particular, need common standards for technology
elements.content:
Diagram type: Conceptual trajectory of technology standards adoption in developing countries across three phases: Adapt, Align, and Author along a 'Development trajectory'.

Phases:
1. Adapt: 'Adapt international standards for the domestic market.'
2. Align: 'Align domestic market with international standards.'
3. Author: 'Shape international standards with the global community.'

Vertical axis labeled 'Specifications', horizontal axis labeled 'Development trajectory'.

Lines/Curves:
- International standards line (horizontal dashed/solid line).
- Domestic standards line.
- Two competing standards Si and Sj diverging towards specifications, with International standards as the central baseline trajectory.

Source: WDR 2025 team.
Note: Si and Sj refer to two different competing standards.
